title: ‘Love Story’ Episode 6: Insider’s Recap of JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette’s Secret Wedding (“Who Did Carole Radziwill Piss Off?”)
summary: A former 'George' magazine staffer reacts to "The Wedding," the sixth installment of Ryan Murphy's FX series about the JFK Jr.-Carolyn Bessette romance, and reveals what the show left out about the top-secret nuptials.
